items.q: How accurate is the competitor information?
items.a: It reads public data, so domain age, tags and pages are reliable, while traffic is not shown because no free tool can measure another site's traffic exactly.

items.q: How should I use the comparison?
items.a: Look for gaps: faster pages, missing schema, a social channel they ignore or an ad pixel that shows they advertise. Then plan what to do better.

items.q: Is the competitor analysis tool free?
items.a: Yes. The competitor analysis kit is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.

items.q: Do competitors know I checked them?
items.a: No. The tool reads public information such as a site's home page, robots.txt and sitemap, the same as any visitor or search engine. It runs through our server.

items.q: Can you build a full competitor and SEO plan for me?
items.a: Yes. Our SEO team starts with competitor research as part of the plan.
